scope: Reusable source-grounded translation checks, no video-specific answers or quantities.

rules.guidance: 咁滯 may indicate almost, nearly or approximately; do not turn a near event into an actual event, or into stagnation.
多得 may introduce because of / thanks to, not many reasons. Read the whole clause.
難睇 describing poor market/chart performance can mean ugly, not hard to understand.
Preserve arithmetic operators such as up volume minus down volume, all signs, thresholds and units exactly as spoken.
Distinguish issuance coupon from current yield. Do not add a technical classification when the source is ambiguous.
平均線 is moving average. Preserve the spoken period and daily/weekly timeframe.
蚊 alone does not identify a currency. Do not add USD or a currency symbol without source support.
Keep each numerator with the correct denominator. Overlapping populations are not necessarily additional or disjoint sets.
A downside target level is not a decline amount. Preserve fall to versus fall by.
Political midterm year is not midyear or medium term. Preserve the supplied year, do not substitute a learned year.
Preserve actual versus conditional versus forecast. Do not weaken will to could or strengthen could to will.
Keep each pronoun, issuer, stock, index and indicator attached to its own predicate. Identify what breaks below what.
重新買返 may mean investors buy again rather than a company repurchases shares. Use the actual subject.
Read fractions, names, negation and complete clauses across cue boundaries; distribute meaning once, never repeat it in adjacent cues.
Creditworthiness, credit rating, yield and share price are distinct concepts. Unresolved acoustic terms must not be guessed from a chart alone.
Do not add historical qualifiers, brands, chart figures, missing verbs or factual corrections from outside the supplied source.
Preserve percent versus percentage points in each language. A bond-yield relative increase is not automatically a percentage-point increase.
Preserve a spoken ticker/abbreviation. Do not invent an agency, organization or full name from its letters; keep the source name when no expansion is provided.
Preserve each explicit year and relative time such as last week. A nearby earlier year cannot replace a different resistance-level year.
Distinguish decline duration from decline amount, one-day pullback from one day of gains, slower from less slowly, and poor from by far the worst.

A second translation pass can regress correct information. Review a local proposed edit against the source; do not assume a wholesale rewrite is better. Same-model clean audit is not independent acceptance.

When Bollinger Bands are identified, normalize the spoken medium line/median line to middle band or middle line in English. Never change medium term in unrelated text. Preserve daily/weekly and the correct indicator object.

Distinguish the lower portion of the Bollinger Bands, the lower band/support, a close below the band, and an intraday wick below it. 下方/下面 does not alone establish a completed break outside the entire band. If source wording is ambiguous, flag it rather than assert a breakout.

In sector-relative-performance commentary, an approved lead緊 means leading the market. An unresolved 呢緊/嚟緊 source sound must be reviewed, not translated as tight-market ones or guessed to mean leading. Genuine upcoming-market language remains future-oriented.

突破之後落返嚟再探一次都正常 may describe a hypothetical/normal retest: a pullback to retest would be normal. Do not turn it into came back down and tested unless the source establishes the retest actually happened.
即係 is an explanation/connector, not straight/directly. Going to a target must not gain an unspoken direct-path claim. Preserve possible/could and do not imply the target is guaranteed.

A source amount can conflict with its same-object chart even when a reference agrees. Raise source uncertainty; do not silently change units, divide by ten, or override the approved source with plotted values. No remembered per-video answer is a general numeric rule.

Read numeric continuations across cue boundaries as one amount, including Chinese tens plus units and minus/decimal English words. Do not translate the fragments into unrelated numbers. Flag display splits of a number or technical name for timing review; never invent timestamps or omit fragments.

Before returning adjacent cues, read their joined English. Avoid duplicate within one day/in one day for one source duration, leading orphan punctuation, and literal geopolitical relationship where the source means because of geopolitical circumstances/tensions. Do not remove real repeated speaker claims.

In an inflation-based rationale for a rate decision, 有權 may mean having grounds/justification; do not automatically introduce institutional authority. Preserve literal authority when that is actually the subject.
